shortBio.en: Libertines co-frontman; twin-vocal garage with Pete Doherty.
shortBio.zh: Libertines 联合主唱；与 Pete Doherty 的双人声车库。

body.en: Born 1978, Basingstoke. Co-lead vocals and guitar in the Libertines. Shares the front line with Doherty on early UK indie singles.
body.zh: 1978 年生于 Basingstoke。Libertines 联合主唱与吉他。早期英国独立单曲上与 Doherty 分担前排。
